en: Pasting a new token replaces the current connection. If you revoke the token in BotFather, paste the new one here straight away.
am: አዲስ ቶክን መለጠፍ አሁን ያለውን ግንኙነት ይተካል። በBotFather ቶክኑን ከሰረዙ አዲሱን ወዲያውኑ እዚህ ይለጥፉ።
om: Tookinii haaraa maxxansuun walqabsiisa ammaa bakka bu'a. BotFather keessatti tookinii yoo haqxan, isa haaraa battalumatti asitti maxxansaa.
ti: ሓድሽ ቶክን ምልጣፍ ነቲ ዘሎ ርክብ ይትክኦ። ኣብ BotFather ቶክን እንተሰሪዝኩም፣ ነቲ ሓድሽ ብቕጽበት ኣብዚ ለጥፉዎ።

sw: Kubandika tokeni mpya hubadilisha muunganisho wa sasa. Ukifuta tokeni katika BotFather, bandika mpya hapa mara moja.
note: Help text: pasting a new token replaces the old one, and a token revoked in BotFather must be re-pasted. 'Revoke' is BotFather's own action name.

en: The stored token no longer works — it was revoked in BotFather. Paste the current token to reconnect.
am: የተቀመጠው ቶክን ከአሁን በኋላ አይሰራም — በBotFather ተሰርዟል። ለመገናኘት አሁን ያለውን ቶክን ይለጥፉ።
om: Tookiniin kuufame kana booda hin hojjetu — BotFather keessatti haqameera. Walqabsiisuuf tookinii ammaa maxxansaa.
ti: እቲ ዝተቐመጠ ቶክን ደጊም ኣይሰርሕን እዩ — ኣብ BotFather ተሰሪዙ እዩ። ንምርኻብ ነቲ ሕጂ ዘሎ ቶክን ለጥፉ።

sw: Tokeni iliyohifadhiwa haifanyi kazi tena — ilifutwa katika BotFather. Bandika tokeni ya sasa ili kuunganisha upya.

en: Telegram is pointing somewhere else — paste the token again to fix it.

am: ቡድንዎ በአንድ ጠቅታ የሚልካቸው የተቀመጡ ምላሾች። እያንዳንዱ በሚያገለግሉት ቋንቋ ሁሉ ተጽፏል፤ ደንበኛውም ሁሌም የራሱን ያገኛል።
om: Deebiiwwan olkaa'aman gareen keessan tuqaa tokkoon ergu. Tokkoon tokkoon isaanii afaan isin tajaajiltan hundaan barreeffameera; maamilis yeroo hunda kan isaa argata.
ti: ጋንታኹም ብሓደ ጠውቖ ዝሰዱዎ ዝተዓቀቡ መልስታት። ነፍሲ ወከፎም ብዘገልግሉሉ ኵሉ ቋንቋ ተጻሒፎም፡ ዓሚል ድማ ወትሩ ናቱ ይረክብ።
so: Jawaabo la kaydiyay oo kooxdaadu hal guji ku dirto. Mid walba waxaa lagu qoray luqad kasta oo aad adeegto, macmiilkuna had iyo jeer kiisa buu helaa.
sw: Majibu yaliyohifadhiwa ambayo timu yako hutuma kwa mbofyo mmoja. Kila moja limeandikwa katika kila lugha unayohudumia, na mteja hupata lake kila wakati.
note: Line under the Macros heading. The promise that matters is the second half: a macro is written per language and the customer always receives their own.
Button that opens the blank macro editor.
Form label: the macro's name, which is what agents search by. Phrased as a purpose ('Ask for more detail'), not a code.
Form label: an optional grouping name, so a long macro list stays navigable.

en: After sending, set the ticket to
so: Ka dib markii la diro, tikidhka u beddel
sw: Baada ya kutuma, weka tikiti kuwa
note: Form label: the ticket status applied AFTER the agent sends the reply. Not when the macro is inserted.
Option meaning the macro changes no status.

om: Afaan tokkoon tokkoon isaatiin waan jedhu
so: Waxa ay ku tidhaahdo, luqad kasta
note: Heading of the per-language body editors.
Button that inserts a placeholder into the body being edited.

en: These are replaced with the real values when the macro is used.
am: ማክሮው ጥቅም ላይ ሲውል በእውነተኛ እሴቶች ይተካሉ።
om: Yeroo maakroon fayyadamu gatii dhugaatiin bakka bu'u.
ti: እቲ ማክሮ ኣብ ጥቕሚ ክውዕል ከሎ ብናይ ብሓቂ ዋጋታት ይትካእ።
so: Kuwan waxaa lagu beddelaa qiimayaasha dhabta ah marka makrada la isticmaalo.
sw: Hizi hubadilishwa na thamani halisi wakati makro inatumika.
note: Help text under the insert buttons.
Confirmation after a macro is stored.
Button that removes a macro permanently.
Button that hides a macro from agents without deleting what was already sent under it.
Button that returns a retired macro to the agents' list.
Badge on a macro that is hidden from agents.
How many times a macro has been applied. {n} is a number; the multiplication sign is used as 'times'.
Shown instead of a count when a macro has never been applied.

en: No macros yet. Write the reply your team types most often, once.
am: እስካሁን ማክሮ የለም። ቡድንዎ በጣም የሚደጋግመውን ምላሽ አንድ ጊዜ ይጻፉት።
om: Amma maakroon hin jiru. Deebii gareen keessan yeroo baay'ee barreessu, al tokko barreessaa.
ti: ክሳብ ሕጂ ማክሮ የለን። እቲ ጋንታኹም ብዙሕ ግዜ ዝጽሕፎ መልሲ ሓንሳብ ጽሓፍዎ።
so: Weli makro ma jirto. Jawaabta kooxdaadu ugu badan qorto, hal mar qor.
sw: Bado hakuna makro. Andika jibu ambalo timu yako huandika mara nyingi zaidi, mara moja.
note: Empty state of the Macros page. It says what to do, not that something is missing.
Button in the reply composer that opens the macro picker.
Placeholder of the macro picker's search box.
Confirmation after a macro fills the composer. {lang} is a language name in its own script.

en: This macro has no {want} text, so {got} was inserted. The customer writes in {want}.
am: ይህ ማክሮ የ{want} ጽሑፍ የለውም፤ ስለዚህ {got} ገብቷል። ደንበኛው በ{want} ይጽፋል።
om: Maakroon kun barruu {want} hin qabu, kanaafuu {got} galcheera. Maamilichi {want}n barreessa.
ti: እዚ ማክሮ ናይ {want} ጽሑፍ የብሉን፡ ስለዚ {got} ኣትዩ። እቲ ዓሚል ብ{want} እዩ ዝጽሕፍ።
so: Makradan ma laha qoraal {want} ah, sidaas darteed {got} ayaa la geliyay. Macmiilku wuxuu ku qoraa {want}.
sw: Makro hii haina maandishi ya {want}, kwa hivyo {got} imeingizwa. Mteja anaandika kwa {want}.
note: Warning when the macro had no body in the customer's language. {want} is the customer's language, {got} the one used. The agent must see this BEFORE sending, which is why it names the customer's language twice.
Error when the macro list could not be fetched. {error} is the reason.
Button that opens an existing macro in the editor.
Button that closes the macro editor without saving.
Heading of the setup checklist on the dashboard. Encouraging, not a warning — nothing is wrong.
Progress line. {done} and {total} are numbers.

en: Your desk is set up. Nice work.
so: Miiskaagu wuu diyaar yahay. Shaqo wanaagsan.
sw: Dawati lako liko tayari. Kazi nzuri.
note: Shown when every setup step is complete, just before the card goes away for good.
Button that hides the setup checklist permanently (admins only).
Setup step: connect a messaging channel. Telegram/Viber/WhatsApp/SMS are product names — keep them.

en: Telegram, Viber, WhatsApp or SMS — wherever your customers already write to you.
am: ቴሌግራም፣ ቫይበር፣ ዋትስአፕ ወይም ኤስኤምኤስ — ደንበኞችዎ አስቀድመው በሚጽፉልዎ ቦታ።
om: Telegram, Viber, WhatsApp yookaan SMS — bakka maamiltoonni keessan duraanuu isinii barreessanitti.
ti: ቴለግራም፡ ቫይበር፡ ዋትስኣፕ ወይ ኤስኤምኤስ — ዓማዊልኩም ድሮ ኣብ ዝጽሕፉልኩም ቦታ።
so: Telegram, Viber, WhatsApp ama SMS — meel kasta oo macaamiishaadu horeba kuugu qoraan.
sw: Telegram, Viber, WhatsApp au SMS — popote wateja wako tayari wanapokuandikia.
note: One line saying why that step matters.
Setup step: the first customer message arrives and becomes a ticket.

en: Send yourself a message on a connected channel to see the whole path work.
am: ሙሉውን መንገድ ሲሰራ ለማየት በተገናኘ ቻናል ለራስዎ መልእክት ይላኩ።
om: Karaan guutuun akka hojjetu arguuf, chaanaalii walqunnamsiifame irratti ofii keessaniif ergaa ergaa.
ti: እቲ ምሉእ መስመር ክሰርሕ ንምርኣይ፡ ብዝተራኸበ ቻነል ንነብስኹም መልእኽቲ ስደዱ።
so: Naftaada fariin ugu dir kanaal ku xidhan si aad u aragto habka oo dhan oo shaqeynaya.
sw: Jitumie ujumbe kwenye kituo kilichounganishwa ili uone njia nzima ikifanya kazi.
note: One line saying why that step matters.
Setup step: add teammates to the workspace.

en: Tickets can be assigned once there is somebody to assign them to.
am: የሚመደብላቸው ሰው ሲኖር ቲኬቶች ሊመደቡ ይችላሉ።
om: Namni itti kennamu yeroo jiraatu tikeetiiwwan kennamuu danda'u.
ti: ዝምደበሎም ሰብ ምስ ዝህሉ ትኬታት ክምደቡ ይኽእሉ።
so: Tikidhada waa la qoondayn karaa marka la helo qof loo qoondeeyo.
sw: Tikiti zinaweza kukabidhiwa mara tu kunapokuwa na mtu wa kuzikabidhi.
note: One line saying why that step matters.
Setup step: configure the working week and hours the SLA clock respects.

en: The SLA clock only runs while you are open, so the promise matches the desk.
am: የSLA ሰዓት የሚሄደው ክፍት ሲሆኑ ብቻ ነው፤ ስለዚህ ቃሉ ከዴስኩ ጋር ይጣጣማል።
om: Sa'aatiin SLA yeroo banaa taatan qofa deema, kanaafuu waadaan deeskii waliin walsimaa.
ti: ሰዓት SLA ዝኸይድ ክፉት ከለኹም ጥራይ እዩ፡ ስለዚ እቲ መብጽዓ ምስቲ ዴስክ ይሰማማዕ።
so: Saacadda SLA waxay socotaa oo keliya marka aad furan tahay, sidaas ballanku wuxuu la mid yahay miiska.
sw: Saa ya SLA hukimbia tu unapokuwa wazi, hivyo ahadi inalingana na dawati.
note: One line saying why. 'SLA' is a technical term the industry uses — keep it.
Setup step: write a saved reply. 'Macro' is this product's term for it.

en: The reply your team types most often, saved once — in every language you serve.
am: ቡድንዎ በጣም የሚደጋግመው ምላሽ አንድ ጊዜ ተቀምጦ — በሚያገለግሉት ቋንቋ ሁሉ።
om: Deebiin gareen keessan yeroo baay'ee barreessu, al tokko olkaa'ame — afaan isin tajaajiltan hundaan.
ti: እቲ ጋንታኹም ብዙሕ ግዜ ዝጽሕፎ መልሲ ሓንሳብ ተዓቂቡ — ብዘገልግሉሉ ኵሉ ቋንቋ።
so: Jawaabta kooxdaadu ugu badan qorto, hal mar la kaydiyay — luqad kasta oo aad u adeegto.
sw: Jibu ambalo timu yako huandika mara nyingi zaidi, limehifadhiwa mara moja — kwa kila lugha unayohudumia.
note: One line saying why. The second half is the selling point: one macro, every language.
Header button opening the alert panel: things the desk needs a person to act on.

om: Wanti xiyyeeffannoo keessan barbaadu hin jiru.
so: Wax fiiro gaar ah u baahan ma jiro.
note: Empty state of the alert panel. Reassuring, not an error — nothing is wrong.
Button clearing every alert currently listed.
Alert reason: the ticket is past the time the workspace promised to reply by.

so: Wuu u dhow yahay waqtiga jawaabta
note: Alert reason: the ticket is close to that deadline but has not missed it yet — there is still time to act.

om: Namni itti kenname utuu hin jiraatin eegaa jira
so: Wuu sugayaa iyadoo aan cidna loo qoondayn
note: Alert reason: nobody has taken the ticket. Not about lateness; about ownership.
Ticket rail label for the customer's satisfaction score.
Wallboard stat: the average satisfaction score for tickets resolved today.
The denominator under the satisfaction average. {n} is a number — an average from one reply and from ninety are different facts, which is why the count is always shown.
Shown where a ticket has no score and none was asked for.

om: Qorannoon ergameera, ammatti deebiin hin jiru
so: Sahan la diray, weli jawaab ma jirto
note: Shown when the survey went out but the customer has not answered yet.
Ticket rail heading: what the ticket is ABOUT, as opposed to which channel it came from or which queue handles it.
Placeholder of the box where an agent types a new or existing tag.
Shown on a ticket carrying no tags.
Accessible label of the small x that takes a tag off a ticket.

so: Waxaa la tusayaa tikidhada lagu astaystay {tag}
note: Banner on the ticket list when it was opened by clicking a tag. {tag} is the tag name, which is user content and is never translated.
Error when a tag could not be saved. {error} is the reason.
Sidebar item: historical reporting, as opposed to the live wallboard.
Heading of the reports page.

en: What came in, what it was about, and how you handled it — compared with the period before.
am: ምን እንደገባ፣ ስለ ምን እንደነበረ እና እንዴት እንደያዙት — ካለፈው ወቅት ጋር ተነጻጽሮ።
om: Maaltu akka seene, waa'ee maalii akka ture fi akkamitti akka qabdan — yeroo darbee waliin wal bira qabamee.
ti: እንታይ ከም ዝኣተወ፡ ብዛዕባ እንታይ ከም ዝነበረ፡ ከመይ ከም ዝሓዝኩምዎ — ምስቲ ዝሓለፈ እዋን ብምንጽጻር።
so: Waxa soo galay, waxa ku saabsanaa, iyo sidaad u maaraysay — marka la barbardhigo mudadii hore.
sw: Kilichoingia, kilihusu nini, na mlivyoshughulikia — ikilinganishwa na kipindi kilichotangulia.
note: Line under it. The comparison with the previous period is the point of the page.
Date-range option: the last seven days.
Date-range option: the last thirty days.
Date-range option: the last ninety days.
Metric: how many tickets were opened in the period.
Metric: the MIDDLE time to first reply, not the average — one very late ticket must not move it.
Metric: the middle time from opening to resolved.
Metric: the share of answered tickets whose first reply beat its SLA promise.
Chart heading: the most common tags. Phrased as the question a manager is actually asking.
Chart heading: which languages customers wrote in. This is the report no competitor in this market produces.

en: No tags yet. Tag a few tickets and this becomes the most useful chart here.
am: እስካሁን መለያ የለም። ጥቂት ቲኬቶችን ይለዩ፤ ይህም እዚህ ያለው በጣም ጠቃሚ ገበታ ይሆናል።
om: Amma mallattoon hin jiru. Tikeetii muraasa mallattaa'aa; kunis chaartii asitti baay'ee fayyadu ta'a.
ti: ክሳብ ሕጂ መለለዪ የለን። ውሑዳት ትኬታት መልልዩ፡ እዚ ድማ ኣብዚ ዘሎ ዝያዳ ጠቓሚ ገበታ ይኸውን።
so: Weli astaan ma jirto. Astee tikidho yar oo kani wuxuu noqonayaa jaantuska ugu faa'iidada badan halkan.
sw: Bado hakuna lebo. Weka lebo kwenye tikiti chache na hii itakuwa chati muhimu zaidi hapa.
note: Empty state of the topics chart. It says what to do, not that something is missing.
Change vs the previous period, in the good direction. {pct} is a percentage like '25%'.
Change vs the previous period, in the bad direction. {pct} is a percentage.

so: Aad u yar in la barbardhigo
note: Shown instead of a change when there were too few tickets for a comparison to mean anything. A percentage on three tickets is noise, and printed next to an arrow it gets repeated as a trend.

om: Ammatti wanti wal bira qabamu hin jiru
note: Shown when the previous period has no data to compare against.
The denominator under a metric. {n} is how many observations it rests on.

om: Yeroo kana keessa homaa hin jiru
note: Shown where a chart or metric has nothing in the chosen period.

en: This might already answer your question:
om: Kun gaaffii keessan duraanuu deebisuu danda'a:
ti: እዚ ንሕቶኹም ኣቐዲሙ ክምልሶ ይኽእል እዩ፦
so: Tan waxaa laga yaabaa inay horeba ka jawaabto su'aashaada:
sw: Hii huenda tayari ikajibu swali lako:
note: CUSTOMER-FACING (widget): shown above suggested articles, BEFORE a ticket is opened. It offers, never asserts — the search may be wrong.
CUSTOMER-FACING (widget): the customer confirms an article answered them, and no ticket is created.

so: Maya, weli caawimaad baan u baahanahay
note: CUSTOMER-FACING (widget): the customer rejects the suggestions; their original message is sent as normal. This must always be available — a customer must never be trapped in a search result.
CUSTOMER-FACING (widget): expands a suggested article to read it.
Sidebar item: the knowledge base.
Heading of the knowledge base page.

en: Answers written once. A customer who finds one never waits for a person — and never becomes a ticket.
am: አንድ ጊዜ የተጻፉ መልሶች። አንዱን የሚያገኝ ደንበኛ ሰው አይጠብቅም — ቲኬትም አይሆንም።
om: Deebiiwwan al tokko barreeffaman. Maamilli tokko argatu nama hin eegu — tikeetiis hin ta'u.
ti: ሓንሳብ እተጻሕፉ መልስታት። ሓደ ዝረክብ ዓሚል ንሰብ ኣይጽበን — ትኬትውን ኣይኸውንን።
so: Jawaabo hal mar la qoray. Macmiil hela mid ma sugo qof — mana noqdo tikidh.
sw: Majibu yaliyoandikwa mara moja. Mteja anayepata moja hasubiri mtu — wala hawi tikiti.
note: Line under it. The point is stated plainly: an answer found is a ticket never created.
Button opening the blank article editor.
Form label: the article's title, per language. It is what a customer is offered, so it must read as an answer to a question.
Form label: the article body, per language.
Badge on an article customers can be shown.
Badge on an article only staff can see.
Button making an article visible to customers.
Button hiding an article from customers again.

so: Wuxuu ka jawaabay {n} macmiil tikidh la'aan
note: How many customers this article answered without a ticket being opened. {n} is a number. This counts only customers who SAID it answered them, not views.

en: No articles yet. Write the answer your team repeats most, once.
am: እስካሁን ጽሑፍ የለም። ቡድንዎ በጣም የሚደጋግመውን መልስ አንድ ጊዜ ይጻፉ።
om: Amma barruun hin jiru. Deebii gareen keessan irra deddeebi'u, al tokko barreessaa.
ti: ክሳብ ሕጂ ጽሑፍ የለን። እቲ ጋንታኹም ብዙሕ ግዜ ዝደግሞ መልሲ ሓንሳብ ጽሓፉ።
so: Weli maqaal ma jiro. Qor jawaabta kooxdaadu ugu badan ku celiso, hal mar.
sw: Bado hakuna makala. Andika jibu ambalo timu yako hurudia zaidi, mara moja.
note: Empty state of the knowledge base. It says what to do, not that something is missing.
Bulk-action button: apply one saved reply to every selected ticket.
Heading of the confirmation shown BEFORE a bulk send. In bulk there is no composer to read, so this screen is the only review that happens.

so: {n} macmiil ayaa tan ku heli doona {lang}
note: One line per language in the batch. {n} is a count, {lang} a language name in its own script. Grouping by language is the point: the same button sends different texts and the agent reads at most one of them fluently.

en: {n} wrote in {from} — this macro has no {from} text, so they receive {lang}
am: {n}ቱ በ{from} ጽፈዋል፤ ይህ ማክሮ የ{from} ጽሑፍ ስለሌለው በ{lang} ይቀበላሉ
om: {n} {from}n barreessan; maakroon kun barruu {from} waan hin qabneef {lang}n fudhatu
ti: {n} ብ{from} ጽሒፎም፡ እዚ ማክሮ ናይ {from} ጽሑፍ ስለ ዘይብሉ ብ{lang} ክቕበሉ እዮም
so: {n} waxay ku qoreen {from}, makradan qoraal {from} ah ma laha, sidaas darteed waxay heli doonaan {lang}
sw: {n} waliandika kwa {from}, makro hii haina maandishi ya {from}, hivyo watapokea {lang}
note: Warning within a language group: some customers wrote in a language this macro has no text for, so they receive a different one. {n} is a count, {from} the language they WROTE in (the one that is missing), {lang} the language they will RECEIVE. Naming {from} is the point — it is the language somebody would have to write for this not to happen again. An earlier version named only the received language, which read as 'they have no English text' about the people being given English.

en: {n} cannot be reached on their channel and will be skipped
om: {n} karaa chaanaalii isaaniitiin bira ga'uun hin danda'amu; ni darbamu
so: {n} lagama gaari karo kanaalkooda, waana la boodi doonaa
sw: {n} hawawezi kufikiwa kwenye kituo chao na wataruka
note: Warning that some selected tickets have no channel to reply on (a walk-in, a logged phone call) and will be skipped. {n} is a count.
The button that actually sends. It names the number of PEOPLE, not tickets — that is what makes the weight of it clear.
Button text while a bulk send is running.
Confirmation after every message was delivered. {n} is a count.

en: Sent to {sent}, but {failed} could not be delivered
so: Loo diray {sent}, laakiin {failed} lama gaadhsiin karin
note: Confirmation after a PARTIAL send. {sent} and {failed} are counts. Reporting the failures is the point — '40 sent' when 37 were is the failure this wording exists to prevent.

en: None of the selected tickets can be replied to on a channel
am: ከተመረጡት ቲኬቶች መካከል በቻናል ሊመለስላቸው የሚችል የለም
om: Tikeetiiwwan filataman keessaa kan chaanaaliidhaan deebi'amuu danda'u hin jiru
ti: ካብቶም እተመርጹ ትኬታት ብቻነል ክምለሰሎም ዝኽእል የለን
so: Tikidhada la doortay midna kanaal lagama jawaabi karo
sw: Hakuna tikiti yoyote iliyochaguliwa inayoweza kujibiwa kwenye kituo
note: Shown when no selected ticket has a channel to reply on, so there is nothing to send.
The quick-create button in the top bar. One word — it sits next to the search box.
Menu item: record a ticket that did not arrive on a channel.
Menu item: record a person.
Nav item and page title for the customer directory.

en: The people behind the tickets. Recording someone once means the next agent they reach already knows them.
am: ከቲኬቶቹ ጀርባ ያሉት ሰዎች። አንድ ጊዜ የተመዘገበ ሰው በሚቀጥለው ጊዜ የሚያገኘው ወኪል አስቀድሞ ያውቀዋል።
om: Namoota tikeetiiwwan duuba jiran. Nama al tokko galmeessuun, yeroo itti aanu bakka bu'aan inni argatu duraan isa beeka jechuudha.
ti: ኣብ ትሕቲ እቶም ትኬታት ዘለዉ ሰባት። ሓደ ግዜ እተመዝገበ ሰብ፡ ኣብ ዝቕጽል ዝረኽቦ ወኪል ኣቐዲሙ ይፈልጦ።
so: Dadka tikidhada ka danbeeya. Qofka hal mar la diiwaan geliyo, wakiilka xiga ee uu la xiriiro horey buu u yaqaan.
sw: Watu walio nyuma ya tiketi. Kumsajili mtu mara moja kunamaanisha wakala atakayemhudumia baadaye tayari anamjua.
note: Says what the directory is FOR, not what it contains.

en: No customers yet. Add the person you are talking to, or name the customer on a ticket that arrived anonymously.
am: እስካሁን ደንበኛ የለም። እያነጋገሩት ያለውን ሰው ያክሉ፣ ወይም ስም-አልባ በደረሰ ቲኬት ላይ ደንበኛውን ይሰይሙ።
om: Amma maamilli hin jiru. Nama waliin haasoftu dabali, yookaan tikeetii maqaa malee dhufe irratti maamilicha moggaasi.
ti: ክሳብ ሕጂ ዓሚል የለን። ነቲ እትዛረቦ ሰብ ወስኽ፡ ወይ ኣብቲ ብዘይ ስም ዝመጸ ትኬት ነቲ ዓሚል ሰይሞ።
so: Weli macmiil ma jiro. Ku dar qofka aad la hadlayso, ama magacaw macmiilka tikidhka magac la'aanta ah u yimid.
sw: Bado hakuna wateja. Mwongeze mtu unayezungumza naye, au mtaje mteja kwenye tiketi iliyofika bila jina.
note: Empty state. Names both ways a customer gets recorded, so it is a next step rather than a statement that something is missing.

en: Search by name, phone or email
so: Ku raadi magac, taleefan ama iimayl
sw: Tafuta kwa jina, simu au barua pepe
note: Placeholder in the directory search box.
Field label.
Field label.
Field label.
Field label for free text staff keep about a customer.
Field label. 'Prefer' matters — it is the language the desk will WRITE to them in, not one detected once.

en: The phone number is how the same person is recognised next time. 09… or 07…, or the full international form.
am: የስልክ ቁጥሩ ተመሳሳይ ሰው በሚቀጥለው ጊዜ የሚታወቅበት ነው። 09… ወይም 07…፣ ወይም ሙሉ ዓለም አቀፍ ቅርጽ።
om: Lakkoofsi bilbilaa akkaataa namni sun yeroo itti aanu ittiin beekamuudha. 09… yookaan 07…, yookaan bifa idil-addunyaa guutuu.
ti: እቲ ቁጽሪ ተሌፎን እቲ ሰብ ኣብ ዝቕጽል ግዜ ዝልለየሉ እዩ። 09… ወይ 07…፡ ወይ ምሉእ ኣህጉራዊ ቅርጺ።
so: Lambarka taleefanka ayaa ah sida qofkaas mar kale loo aqoonsanayo. 09… ama 07…, ama qaabka caalamiga ah ee buuxa.
sw: Namba ya simu ndiyo njia ya kumtambua mtu huyo tena. 09… au 07…, au muundo kamili wa kimataifa.
note: Explains why the phone number is required. It is the identity, not a contact detail.

en: You already had this customer on file — opening their record instead of making a second one.
am: ይህ ደንበኛ አስቀድሞ በመዝገብ ላይ ነበር — ሁለተኛ ከመፍጠር ይልቅ መዝገባቸው ተከፍቷል።
om: Maamilli kun duraanuu galmee keessa ture — lammaffaa uumuu mannaa galmee isaanii banameera.
ti: እዚ ዓሚል ኣቐዲሙ ኣብ መዝገብ ነይሩ — ካልኣይ ካብ ምፍጣር ኣብ ክንዲ መዝገቦም ተኸፊቱ።
so: Macmiilkan horey buu diiwaanka ugu jiray — halkii mid labaad la sameyn lahaa, diiwaankiisii ayaa la furay.
sw: Mteja huyu tayari alikuwa kwenye kumbukumbu — badala ya kutengeneza wa pili, rekodi yake imefunguliwa.
note: Shown when saving a 'new' customer matched somebody already on file. Not an error — the right thing happened and the agent should know.

Count on a directory row. {n} is a number. Deliberately a LABEL plus a number rather than "{n} tickets" — embedding a count inside a noun phrase needs plural rules, and they differ across all six languages, so an inflected form would be wrong in most of them. Keep the noun uninflected.
Heading above a customer's past tickets.

en: No tickets yet for this customer.
om: Maamila kanaaf amma tikeetiin hin jiru.
ti: ነዚ ዓሚል ክሳብ ሕጂ ትኬት የለን።
sw: Bado hakuna tiketi kwa mteja huyu.
note: Empty state on a customer with no tickets.
Title of the manual ticket form. 'Log' not 'create' — the work already happened, this is recording it.

en: A call you took, someone at the counter — work that did not arrive on a channel still belongs on the desk.
am: የተቀበሉት ጥሪ፣ በቆጣሪው ላይ ያለ ሰው — በቻናል ያልደረሰ ሥራም ቢሆን የዴስኩ ነው።
om: Bilbila fudhatte, nama fuuldura teessoo jiru — hojiin karaa chaanaalii hin dhufin illee kan deeskii ti.
ti: እተቐበልካዮ ጻውዒት፡ ኣብ መቐበሊ ዘሎ ሰብ — ብቻነል ዘይመጸ ስራሕ እውን ናይቲ ደስክ እዩ።
so: Wac aad qaadatay, qof kaunterka jooga — shaqada aan kanaal ku iman weli waxay leedahay deeskaas.
sw: Simu uliyopokea, mtu aliye kaunta — kazi ambayo haikuja kupitia kituo bado ni ya dawati hili.
note: Says which situations this form is for.
Field label, phrased as the question an agent would actually ask.
Field label for what the customer said.

en: Recorded as the customer's own first message on the timeline, not as something the desk said.
am: በጊዜ መስመሩ ላይ የደንበኛው የመጀመሪያ መልእክት ሆኖ ይመዘገባል እንጂ ዴስኩ እንዳለው አይደለም።
om: Sarara yeroo irratti akka ergaa jalqabaa maamilichaa galmaa'a malee akka waan deeskiin jedhee miti.
ti: ኣብቲ መስመር ግዜ ከም ናይቲ ዓሚል ቀዳማይ መልእኽቲ እዩ ዝምዝገብ እምበር ከም ናይቲ ደስክ ኣይኮነን።
so: Waxaa loo diiwaan gelinayaa fariinta ugu horreysa ee macmiilka, ma aha wax deesku yiri.
sw: Inarekodiwa kama ujumbe wa kwanza wa mteja mwenyewe, si kama kitu dawati lilisema.
note: Explains that this is recorded as the CUSTOMER's words on the timeline, so an agent does not write it as a reply.
Field label for the channel picker on a manual ticket.
Channel option: a call the agent took.
Channel option: somebody physically present.
Field label for the person the ticket is about. Also the inbox column heading.

en: Search for them, or type a new phone number
am: ይፈልጓቸው፣ ወይም አዲስ የስልክ ቁጥር ይተይቡ
om: Isaan barbaadi, yookaan lakkoofsa bilbilaa haaraa barreessi
ti: ድለዮም፡ ወይ ሓድሽ ቁጽሪ ተሌፎን ጽሓፍ
so: Raadi, ama qor lambar taleefan cusub
sw: Watafute, au andika namba mpya ya simu
note: Placeholder for the customer picker: search existing OR type a new number to create one inline.

en: A logged call has no channel to reply on. Answer this one by calling them back — the desk cannot send to it.
am: የተመዘገበ ጥሪ የሚመልስበት ቻናል የለውም። ይህን መልሰው በመደወል ይመልሱ — ዴስኩ ወደዚህ መላክ አይችልም።
om: Bilbilli galmaa'e karaa deebii itti kennan hin qabu. Kana deebisanii bilbiluudhaan deebisi — deeskiin gara kanaatti erguu hin danda'u.
ti: እተመዝገበ ጻውዒት መልሲ ዝወሃበሉ ቻነል የብሉን። ነዚ መሊስካ ብምድዋል መልሶ — እቲ ደስክ ናብዚ ክሰድድ ኣይክእልን።
so: Wicitaan la diiwaan geliyay ma laha kanaal lagaga jawaabo. Kan uga jawaab adigoo dib u wacaya — deesku ma diri karo.
sw: Simu iliyorekodiwa haina kituo cha kujibia. Jibu hii kwa kuwapigia tena — dawati haliwezi kutuma humo.
note: Shown on a ticket with no channel behind it. The desk genuinely cannot send a message to a logged phone call, and saying so is the point — the alternative is a composer that silently fails.
Confirmation after logging. {n} is the ticket number.
Button on a ticket that arrived anonymously.

en: This ticket arrived without a name. Linking it to a customer carries the identity onto everything they send next.
am: ይህ ቲኬት ያለ ስም ደርሷል። ከደንበኛ ጋር ማገናኘት ማንነቱን ቀጥሎ ወደሚልኩት ሁሉ ያሸጋግራል።
om: Tikeetiin kun maqaa malee dhufe. Maamila waliin walqabsiisuun eenyummaa isaa gara waan itti aanee ergan hundatti dabarsa.
ti: እዚ ትኬት ብዘይ ስም እዩ መጺኡ። ምስ ዓሚል ምትእስሳር ነቲ መንነት ናብ ዝቕጽል ዝሰዱዎ ኩሉ የሰጋግሮ።
so: Tikidhkan wuxuu yimid magac la'aan. Isku xirka macmiil wuxuu aqoonsiga u gudbinayaa wax kasta oo ay xigta soo diraan.
sw: Tiketi hii ilifika bila jina. Kuiunganisha na mteja hupeleka utambulisho kwenye kila kitu watakachotuma baadaye.
note: Explains that naming the customer also teaches the CONVERSATION who they are, so the next message already knows.
Shown on a customer's page. {date} is a formatted date. 'Customer since' rather than 'created' — the record is about a relationship, not a row.
Stat label on a customer's page: how many of their tickets are open right now.
Stat label on a customer's page: how many tickets they have ever opened.
Button that turns the customer's details into an editable form.
Button on a customer's page that starts a ticket already attached to them. The point is that a known caller does not get re-identified.

en: What the team should know before speaking to them. Staff only — never shown to the customer.
am: ከማነጋገራቸው በፊት ቡድኑ ማወቅ ያለበት። ለሠራተኞች ብቻ — ለደንበኛው በጭራሽ አይታይም።
om: Isaan waliin haasa'uun dura wanti gareen beekuu qabu. Hojjettootaaf qofa — maamilichaaf gonkumaa hin argisiifamu.
ti: ምስኦም ቅድሚ ምዝራብ እቲ ጋንታ ክፈልጦ ዘለዎ። ንሰራሕተኛታት ጥራይ — ንዓሚል ፈጺሙ ኣይረአን።
so: Waxa kooxdu ogaan lahayd ka hor inta aanay la hadlin. Shaqaalaha kaliya — waligeed macmiilka lama tuso.
sw: Kile timu inapaswa kujua kabla ya kuzungumza nao. Wafanyakazi pekee — hakionyeshwi kamwe kwa mteja.
note: Under the notes field. Says plainly that notes are internal — an agent who is unsure will otherwise write nothing useful.
Empty state where a customer has no notes.
Brief confirmation after saving a customer's details.
Link from one customer's page back to the directory.
Link from a ticket's customer rail through to that customer's full record.
Heading of the rail on a customer's record. The question it answers is 'can the desk actually message this person', which is not the same as what contact details are on file.
Label above the list of channels this customer has actually written in on.

en: They have never written in — every ticket here was logged by staff, so the desk cannot message them.
am: ጽፈው አያውቁም — እዚህ ያለው እያንዳንዱ ቲኬት በሠራተኞች የተመዘገበ ነው፣ ስለዚህ ዴስኩ መልእክት ሊልክላቸው አይችልም።
om: Takkaa hin barreessine — tikeetiin as jiru hundi hojjettootaan galmaa'e, kanaaf deeskiin ergaa isaanii erguu hin danda'u.
ti: ፈጺሞም ጽሒፎም ኣይፈልጡን — ኩሉ እዚ ትኬት ብሰራሕተኛታት እዩ ተመዝጊቡ፡ ስለዚ እቲ ደስክ መልእኽቲ ክሰደሎም ኣይክእልን።
so: Waligood ma soo qorin — tikidh kasta oo halkan ah shaqaaluhu diiwaan geliyeen, sidaas darteed deesku fariin uma diri karo.
sw: Hawajawahi kuandika — kila tiketi hapa ilisajiliwa na wafanyakazi, hivyo dawati haliwezi kuwatumia ujumbe.
note: Shown for a customer who only exists because staff logged calls for them. The desk genuinely cannot send them anything, and saying so is the point.
A tel: link. Opens the phone app or a softphone.
A mailto: link. Deliberately the operator's own mail client — a message sent from there is NOT on the ticket, which is why it sits under 'how to reach them' rather than beside the reply box.

en: What they contacted you about before
ti: ቅድሚ ሕጂ ብዛዕባ እንታይ ከም ዝረኸቡኻ
note: Heading of the panel beside the log-a-ticket form: what this customer has contacted you about before.

en: Pick a customer and anything they have contacted you about before appears here.
am: ደንበኛ ይምረጡ፤ ከዚህ በፊት ያነጋገሩዎት ማንኛውም ጉዳይ እዚህ ይታያል።
om: Maamila filadhu; wanti duraan si qunnaman kamiyyuu asitti mul'ata.
ti: ዓሚል ምረጽ፤ ቅድሚ ሕጂ ዝረኸቡኻ ዝኾነ ነገር ኣብዚ ይረአ።
so: Dooro macmiil, wax kasta oo ay hore kaaga soo xiriireen halkan ayay ka muuqan doonaan.
sw: Chagua mteja, na chochote walichowasiliana nawe kuhusu awali kitaonekana hapa.
note: Empty state of that panel before a customer is chosen. Says what will appear rather than that something is missing.
Button that opens the right-hand context panel. One word — it sits in a crowded top bar. It is the SAME control that closes the panel; the label changes to ui_context_hide when it is open.
The same button once the panel is open.

The fifth item in the phone's bottom bar, opening everything that does not fit. Must be SHORT — it shares a 390px row with four other labels, and the bar overflowed horizontally when the labels were long.
Heading of the live preview beside the macro editor. Phrased from the CUSTOMER's side on purpose — the point of the preview is that an author writes a template but a person reads a message.

en: Type a body and the customer's own copy appears here, with the placeholders filled in.
am: ጽሑፍ ይተይቡ፤ የደንበኛው ቅጂ ቦታ ያዢዎቹ ተሞልተው እዚህ ይታያል።
om: Barruu barreessi; garagalchi maamilichaa iddoo qabdoonni guutamanii asitti mul'ata.
ti: ጽሑፍ ጽሓፍ፤ ቅዳሕ እቲ ዓሚል እቶም ቦታ ሓዞቲ ተመሊኦም ኣብዚ ይረአ።
so: Qor qoraal, nuqulka macmiilka oo meelbeddelayaashu buuxsanyihiin ayaa halkan ka soo muuqan doona.
sw: Andika maandishi, na nakala ya mteja itaonekana hapa, na vishikilizi vimejazwa.
note: Empty state of the preview. Says what will appear, not that something is missing.

en: Shown with example values. A real send uses the actual customer, ticket number and agent.
am: በምሳሌ እሴቶች ታይቷል። ትክክለኛ መላክ ትክክለኛውን ደንበኛ፣ የቲኬት ቁጥር እና ወኪል ይጠቀማል።
om: Gatiiwwan fakkeenyaatiin agarsiifame. Ergaan dhugaa maamila, lakkoofsa tikeetii fi bakka bu'aa dhugaa fayyadama.
ti: ብኣብነታዊ ዋጋታት ተራእዩ። ናይ ብሓቂ ምስዳድ ነቲ ናይ ብሓቂ ዓሚል፡ ቁጽሪ ትኬትን ወኪልን እዩ ዝጥቀም።
so: Waxaa lagu tusay qiyam tusaale ah. Dirid dhab ah waxay isticmaashaa macmiilka, lambarka tikidhka iyo wakiilka dhabta ah.
sw: Imeonyeshwa kwa thamani za mfano. Kutuma halisi hutumia mteja, namba ya tiketi na wakala halisi.
note: Under the preview. Says plainly that the values are examples, so nobody mistakes the sample name for something that will actually be sent.

en: {n} placeholder is not one we recognise, so it is removed from the message: {list}
am: {n} ቦታ ያዢ የማናውቀው ነው፤ ስለዚህ ከመልእክቱ ይወገዳል፦ {list}
om: Iddoo qabduun {n} kan nuti beeknu miti; kanaaf ergaa keessaa haqama: {list}
ti: {n} ቦታ ሓዚ ንሕና እንፈልጦ ኣይኮነን፡ ስለዚ ካብቲ መልእኽቲ ይውገድ፦ {list}
so: {n} meelbeddel ma aha mid aan garanayno, sidaas darteed fariinta waa laga saarayaa: {list}
sw: Kishikilizi {n} si tunachokitambua, hivyo kinaondolewa kwenye ujumbe: {list}
note: Warning under the macro preview when the body uses a token we do not know — usually a typo like {{custmer.name}}. {n} is a count, {list} the tokens themselves. It matters because an unknown token is SILENTLY DELETED from what the customer receives: without this the author sees a sentence with a hole in it and no reason why.
Accessible label on the × of an open-ticket tab.
Marker on a tab whose composer holds text that has not been sent. Short — it shares a narrow tab with the subject.

en: This ticket has a reply you have not sent. Close it anyway?
am: ይህ ቲኬት ያልላኩት መልስ አለው። ለማንኛውም ይዘጋ?
om: Tikeetiin kun deebii ati hin ergine qaba. Haa ta'uutii cufamuu?
ti: እዚ ትኬት ዘይሰደድካዮ መልሲ ኣለዎ። ብዝኾነ ይዕጾ?
so: Tikidhkan wuxuu leeyahay jawaab aadan dirin. Weli ma xirayaa?
sw: Tiketi hii ina jibu ambalo hujatuma. Ifunge hata hivyo?
note: Asked before closing a tab that holds an unsent reply. The whole reason tabs are safe is that they never lose typing, so this is the one place a confirmation earns its interruption.

Accessible label on the theme control in the top bar, and the heading of the choice it opens. It is the OS-level word for light/dark preference, not a word about colour — 'Theme' would collide with per-tenant branding, which is a different thing entirely.
The light theme. One word — it sits in a narrow menu beside an icon.
The dark theme. One word.

Follow the device's own light/dark setting rather than choosing. Should read as 'whatever my phone or computer is set to', NOT as a technical word like 'System' or 'Automatic' — many users here have never seen an OS setting named that way, and the point is that it changes by itself at dusk.
Control at the foot of the app navigation that folds it to icons. One word — it sits in a 210px rail and must not wrap.
The same control once folded, where only an icon and a tooltip are visible. Says what will EXPAND, since at 56px there is no context to infer it from.
Button above the page content that folds the saved-views rail away. 'Views' is the same word used for the rail's own heading.
The same button once the views rail is folded. It lives on the CONTENT side because the rail it opens is zero pixels wide when shut.
Picker shown when one channel has several vendors behind it — SMS in Ethiopia runs through AfroMessage, GeezSMS or FalconVAS.
Suffix on a field label that is not required. Lower case, it reads as an aside rather than a second label.
The button that stores a channel's credentials. 'Connection', not 'settings' — what is being saved is the link to the outside world.
The same button mid-request.
Confirmation beside the button.

en: Copy this secret now — it is shown once and never again.
am: ይህን ሚስጥር አሁን ይቅዱ — አንድ ጊዜ ብቻ ነው የሚታየው።
om: Iccitii kana amma garagalchi — al tokko qofa mul'ata.
ti: ነዚ ምስጢር ሕጂ ቅዳሕ — ሓንሳብ ጥራይ እዩ ዝረአ።
so: Hadda koobi sirtan — hal mar ayaa la tusayaa.
sw: Nakili siri hii sasa — inaonyeshwa mara moja tu.
note: Shown with a freshly generated webhook secret. Must convey URGENCY: the value is never displayed again and saving anew mints a different one, so a reader who scrolls past has to start over.

en: Point your provider at this address
sw: Elekeza mtoa huduma wako kwenye anwani hii
note: Heading above the INBOUND address. This is the half of a connection an operator cannot guess and nothing used to display — credentials alone only tell the desk how to send, never how to receive.

en: Send the secret in the {header} header.
note: Says which HTTP header carries the secret. {header} is a literal header name and is never translated.
The address a customer sees replies come from. Phrased as a sentence fragment the field completes.

en: Must be an address on a domain you have verified for sending, or replies land in spam.
am: ለመላክ ባረጋገጡት ጎራ ላይ ያለ አድራሻ መሆን አለበት፤ አለበለዚያ መልሶቹ ወደ አይፈለጌ ይገባሉ።
om: Teessoo daaymeenii ergaaf mirkaneessite irratti argamu ta'uu qaba; yoo kanaa achii deebiin gara spam seena.
ti: ንምስዳድ ኣብ ዘረጋገጽካዮ ዶሜን ዘሎ ኣድራሻ ክኸውን ኣለዎ፤ እንተዘየለ መልስታት ናብ ስፓም ይኣትዉ።
so: Waa inuu noqdaa cinwaan ku yaal domain aad u xaqiijisay dirista, haddii kalena jawaabuhu spam bay galayaan.
sw: Lazima iwe anwani kwenye domeni uliyothibitisha kutuma, la sivyo majibu yataingia kwenye spam.
note: Why the domain has to be verified. The consequence — landing in spam — matters more than the rule, so it is stated.
The provider's outbound API endpoint.

en: Must accept a JSON body of from, to, subject and text.
am: from፣ to፣ subject እና text ያለው JSON መቀበል አለበት።
om: JSON from, to, subject fi text qabu fudhachuu qaba.
ti: from፡ to፡ subject ከምኡውን text ዘለዎ JSON ክቕበል ኣለዎ።
so: Waa inuu aqbalaa JSON leh from, to, subject iyo text.
sw: Lazima ikubali JSON yenye from, to, subject na text.
note: The body shape we post. Field names are literal JSON keys and stay in English in every language.
The API key or token itself. Deliberately not 'API key': for some providers it is a bearer token and for others a raw secret.

en: Stored encrypted. Sent only to the address above.
am: ተመስጥሮ ይቀመጣል። ወደ ላይኛው አድራሻ ብቻ ይላካል።
om: Iccitiidhaan olkaa'ama. Gara teessoo armaan olii qofatti ergama.
ti: ተመስጢሩ ይቕመጥ። ናብቲ ኣብ ላዕሊ ዘሎ ኣድራሻ ጥራይ ይስደድ።
so: Si qarsoodi ah ayaa loo kaydiyaa. Waxaa loo diraa cinwaanka kore oo keliya.
sw: Huhifadhiwa kwa usimbaji. Hutumwa kwa anwani iliyo hapo juu pekee.
note: Reassurance about where a credential goes, on the one screen where somebody is asked to paste one.
Which HTTP header the credential travels in.

en: Leave empty for Authorization. Postmark needs X-Postmark-Server-Token.
am: ለAuthorization ባዶ ይተዉት። Postmark X-Postmark-Server-Token ይፈልጋል።
om: Authorization'f duwwaa dhiisi. Postmark X-Postmark-Server-Token barbaada.
ti: ንAuthorization ባዶ ግደፎ። Postmark X-Postmark-Server-Token የድልዮ።
so: Authorization u dhaaf madhan. Postmark wuxuu u baahan yahay X-Postmark-Server-Token.
sw: Acha wazi kwa Authorization. Postmark inahitaji X-Postmark-Server-Token.
note: Names the default and the one provider that differs. Header names are literals and never translated.
The short alphanumeric name an SMS appears to come from.
Meta's numeric id for a WhatsApp number — not the phone number itself, which is a common and costly confusion.
Meta's long-lived token for sending.
Meta's app secret, used to verify that a delivery really came from them.
A phrase WE choose and Meta echoes back during the handshake.

en: Any phrase you choose. Type the same one into Meta when it asks.
am: የመረጡት ማንኛውም ሐረግ። Meta ሲጠይቅ ተመሳሳዩን ይጻፉ።
om: Jecha kamiyyuu ati filatte. Yeroo Meta gaafatu isuma barreessi.
ti: ዝኾነ ዝመረጽካዮ ሓረግ። Meta ምስ ሓተተ ተመሳሳሊ ጽሓፍ።
so: Weedh kasta oo aad dooratid. Marka Meta ku weydiiyo isla midkaas qor.
sw: Kifungu chochote unachochagua. Andika kilekile Meta itakapouliza.
note: Says plainly that the operator invents this one, because every other field on the card is copied FROM Meta and people reasonably assume this one is too.

en: Meta signs each delivery itself — paste this address and your verify token into the Meta dashboard, and nothing else needs sending.
am: Meta እያንዳንዱን መልእክት ራሱ ይፈርማል — ይህን አድራሻና የማረጋገጫ ቶከንዎን በMeta ዳሽቦርድ ውስጥ ይለጥፉ፤ ሌላ መላክ አያስፈልግም።
om: Meta ergaa hunda ofii isaatii mallatteessa — teessoo kanaa fi tookenii mirkaneessaa kee gara daashboordii Meta keessatti maxxansi; kanaan alatti wanti ergamu hin jiru.
ti: Meta ንነፍሲ ወከፍ ምስዳድ ባዕሉ እዩ ዝፍርሞ — ነዚ ኣድራሻን ናትካ ቶከን መረጋገጺን ኣብ ዳሽቦርድ Meta ለጥፎም፤ ካልእ ምስዳድ ኣየድልን።
so: Meta ayaa iyada qudheedu saxeexda dirid kasta — ku dhaji cinwaankan iyo calaamaddaada xaqiijinta dashboard-ka Meta, waxna kale looma baahna in la diro.
sw: Meta hutia saini kila ujumbe yenyewe — bandika anwani hii na tokeni yako ya uthibitisho kwenye dashibodi ya Meta, na hakuna kingine cha kutuma.
note: Replaces the 'send the secret in this header' line on the Meta cards, where that instruction would be WRONG: Meta computes X-Hub-Signature-256 from the app secret itself, so there is nothing for the operator to send. Saying otherwise sends somebody looking for a setting that does not exist.
Heading of the macro editor's action list. Phrased as a WHEN clause, because the list that follows reads as its consequences — 'When this macro runs: set status, add tags'.

en: No actions yet. It will send the reply and change nothing else.
am: እስካሁን ተግባር የለም። መልሱን ብቻ ይልካል፤ ሌላ ምንም አይለውጥም።
om: Hanga ammaatti gochi hin jiru. Deebii qofa erga; waan biraa hin jijjiiru.
ti: ክሳብ ሕጂ ተግባር የለን። መልሲ ጥራይ ይሰድድ፤ ካልእ ኣይቕይርን።
so: Wali ma jiro ficil. Wuxuu dirayaa jawaabta oo keliya, waxna kale ma beddelayo.
sw: Hakuna vitendo bado. Itatuma jibu tu, na haitabadilisha kingine.
note: Shown when a macro only sends words. States the consequence plainly so an empty list does not read as a broken control.
Row label: the action that changes the ticket's status.
Row label: the action that changes the ticket's priority.
Row label: the action that adds tags.
Accessible label on the × that deletes an action row, and on the × on each individual tag.
Inside the tag box. Names the key that commits, because nothing else on screen says a comma or Enter is what adds it.
One line of the summary under a macro in the list, saying what it does besides sending words. {value} is a status name.
As above, for priority. {value} is a priority name.
As above, for tags. {list} is the tags themselves, comma-separated — the names matter more than the count, so they are shown rather than a number.
First section of Settings: the desk's own identity. 'Workspace' rather than 'General' — it names the thing being configured instead of the leftovers drawer.
Heading of the name + time zone card.
The organization's display name.

en: Customers see this in automatic replies and on the chat widget.
am: ደንበኞች ይህን በራስ-ሰር መልሶች እና በውይይት መስኮቱ ላይ ያዩታል።
om: Maamiltoonni deebii ofumaan kennamu fi foddaa marii irratti kana ni argu.
ti: ዓማዊል ነዚ ኣብ ኣውቶማቲክ መልስታትን ኣብ መስኮት ዕላልን ይርእዩዎ።
so: Macaamiishu waxay ku arkaan jawaabaha otomaatigga ah iyo daaqadda sheekada.
sw: Wateja wanaliona katika majibu ya kiotomatiki na kwenye kidirisha cha mazungumzo.
note: Says WHERE a customer sees it, because that is what makes it worth getting right.
The workspace slug, shown read-only.

en: Fixed. It is inside the widget code on your website and inside every webhook address you have given a provider, so changing it would break all of them.
am: ቋሚ ነው። በድረ-ገጽዎ ላይ ባለው የውይይት ኮድ ውስጥና ለአቅራቢዎች በሰጡት እያንዳንዱ የዌብሁክ አድራሻ ውስጥ ስላለ መቀየሩ ሁሉንም ያበላሻል።
om: Hin jijjiiramu. Koodii marii marsariitii kee irra jiru keessaa fi teessoo webhook dhiyeessitootaaf kennite hunda keessa waan jiruuf, jijjiiruun hunda isaanii balleessa.
ti: ቀዋሚ እዩ። ኣብቲ ኣብ መርበብካ ዘሎ ኮድ ዕላልን ኣብ ኩሉ ንኣቕረብቲ ዝሃብካዮ ኣድራሻ ወብሁክን ስለ ዘሎ፡ ምቕያሩ ንኹሎም የበላሽዎም።
so: Waa go'an. Wuxuu ku jiraa koodhka sheekada ee degelkaaga iyo cinwaan kasta oo webhook ah oo aad bixiyayaal siisay, sidaas darteed beddelkiisu dhammaantood wuu burburin lahaa.
sw: Haibadiliki. Ipo ndani ya msimbo wa mazungumzo kwenye tovuti yako na ndani ya kila anwani ya webhook uliyompa mtoa huduma, hivyo kuibadilisha kungeviharibu vyote.
note: Why it cannot be changed. The reason is stated rather than left as a greyed-out box: the slug is inside the widget snippet on the customer's own site and inside every webhook URL a gateway has been pointed at.
The zone business hours and SLA deadlines are counted in.

en: Business hours and every reply deadline are counted in this zone.
am: የሥራ ሰዓታትና እያንዳንዱ የመልስ ገደብ በዚህ ክልል ይቆጠራሉ።
om: Sa'aatiin hojii fi daangaan yeroo deebii hundi naannoo kanaan lakkaa'ama.
ti: ሰዓታት ስራሕን ኩሉ ናይ መልሲ ገደብን በዚ ዞባ እዮም ዝቑጸሩ።
so: Saacadaha shaqada iyo waqti kasta oo jawaab loo qabtay waxaa lagu xisaabiyaa aaggan.
sw: Saa za kazi na kila muda wa mwisho wa kujibu huhesabiwa kwa saa hizi.
note: Names the consequence, since a time zone setting with no stated effect reads as decoration.
Heading: which languages this desk staffs. Phrased as what the TEAM does, not as a feature list.

en: Customers are answered in the language they wrote in, if it is one of these.
am: ደንበኞች ከእነዚህ አንዱ ከሆነ በጻፉበት ቋንቋ ይመለሳሉ።
om: Maamiltoonni yoo isaan keessaa tokko ta'e afaan itti barreessaniin deebii argatu.
ti: ዓማዊል ካብዞም ሓደ እንተኾይኑ በቲ ዝጸሓፉሉ ቋንቋ ይምለሱ።
so: Macaamiisha waxaa loogu jawaabaa luqaddii ay ku qoreen, haddii ay ka mid tahay kuwan.
sw: Wateja hujibiwa kwa lugha waliyoandikia, ikiwa ni miongoni mwa hizi.
note: The rule in one line — a customer gets their own language if it is one of these.
The fallback language. Deliberately NOT called 'default': what it means is what happens when detection fails, and 'fall back to' says that where 'default' does not.

en: Used when we cannot tell what language a message is in.
am: የመልእክቱን ቋንቋ ማወቅ ካልቻልን ጥቅም ላይ ይውላል።
om: Yeroo afaan ergaa adda baasuu hin dandeenye fayyadama.
so: Waa la isticmaalaa marka aynaan garan karin luqadda fariinta.
sw: Hutumika tunaposhindwa kutambua lugha ya ujumbe.
note: When the fallback is used.

so: Magaca goobta shaqada waa loo baahan yahay.
sw: Jina la eneo la kazi linahitajika.
note: Save refused: no name.

so: Magacaasi aad buu u dheer yahay.
note: Save refused: name over the limit.

en: Choose a time zone from the list.
sw: Chagua saa za eneo kutoka orodha.
note: Save refused: unrecognised time zone.

en: Choose at least one language you answer in.
om: Afaan ittiin deebistu yoo xiqqaate tokko filadhu.
so: Dooro ugu yaraan hal luqad oo aad kaga jawaabto.
sw: Chagua angalau lugha moja unayojibu kwayo.
note: Save refused: no languages ticked. An empty set is not 'all languages', it is a desk that cannot answer anybody.

en: Choose a language to fall back to.
note: Save refused: no fallback language chosen.

en: You can only fall back to a language you answer in.
am: መመለስ የሚችሉበት ቋንቋ ብቻ መጠቀም ይችላሉ።
om: Afaan ittiin deebistu qofatti deebi'uu dandeessa.
ti: ናብቲ ትምልሰሉ ቋንቋ ጥራይ ክትምለስ ትኽእል።
so: Waxaad ku noqon kartaa oo kaliya luqad aad kaga jawaabto.
sw: Unaweza kurudi tu kwenye lugha unayojibu kwayo.
note: Save refused: the fallback is a language the desk does not staff. This is the one that fails SILENTLY without the check — every field looks valid on its own, and customers get replies in a language nobody on the team reads.

en: First response is how long a customer waits to hear anything; resolution is how long until the ticket is finished. These are the promises the inbox colours tickets against.
am: የመጀመሪያ ምላሽ ደንበኛው ማንኛውንም ነገር ለመስማት የሚጠብቀው ጊዜ ነው፤ መፍትሔ ደግሞ ቲኬቱ እስኪጠናቀቅ ያለው ጊዜ ነው። ኢንቦክሱ ቲኬቶችን የሚያቀልመው በእነዚህ ቃል ኪዳኖች ላይ ተመስርቶ ነው።
om: Deebiin jalqabaa yeroo maamilli waan tokko dhaga'uuf eegudha; furmaanni immoo hanga tikeetiin xumuramutti yeroo fudhatudha. Inboksiin waadaawwan kanneen irratti hundaa'ee tikeetii halluu godha.
ti: ቀዳማይ መልሲ ማለት ዓሚል ገለ ንኽሰምዕ ዝጽበዮ ግዜ እዩ፤ መፍትሒ ድማ እቲ ትኬት ክሳብ ዝውዳእ ዘሎ ግዜ እዩ። እቲ ኢንቦክስ ንትኬታት ብእዞም መብጽዓታት እዩ ዝሓብሮም።
so: Jawaabta koowaad waa muddada macmiilku sugayo inuu wax maqlo; xallintuna waa ilaa tikidhku dhammaado. Kuwani waa ballamaha uu sanduuqu tikidhada midabka ugu qoro.
sw: Jibu la kwanza ni muda mteja anaosubiri kusikia chochote; utatuzi ni hadi tiketi imalizike. Haya ndiyo maahadi ambayo kikasha hutia rangi tiketi kwa kuyategemea.
note: Above the four rows of minute boxes. Says what the two promises MEAN and that they are what colours the inbox — without it the section is a form rather than a decision.
The same fold control on Settings, where the rail holds SECTIONS rather than saved views. 'Hide views' on a page with no views in it is the console describing its own plumbing.
The same control once the Settings rail is folded.

The combined finished state on the dashboard overview — resolved and closed together. Both mean 'not on anybody's desk', and splitting them would push the chart past the number of hues that stay distinguishable under colour-blindness. They stay separate everywhere a ticket is actually worked.
Heading of the lifecycle card on the dashboard.

en: A snapshot of where all your work sits. Tap any row to see what is in it.
am: ሥራዎ ሁሉ የት እንዳለ ቅጽበታዊ እይታ። በውስጡ ያለውን ለማየት ማንኛውንም ረድፍ ይንኩ።
om: Hojiin kee hundi eessa akka jiru agarsiisa. Waan keessa jiru arguuf sarara kamiyyuu tuqi.
ti: ኩሉ ስራሕካ ኣበይ ከም ዘሎ ቅጽበታዊ ትርኢት። ኣብኡ ዘሎ ንምርኣይ ዝኾነ መስመር ተንክፍ።
so: Muuqaal degdeg ah oo muujinaya meesha shaqadaadu ku taal. Taabo saf kasta si aad u aragto waxa ku jira.
sw: Mtazamo wa haraka wa mahali kazi yako yote ilipo. Gusa safu yoyote kuona kilichomo.
note: The sentence under the title. Says what the card is FOR and that the rows are clickable — so nobody has to click to find out whether clicking does anything. 'Tap' rather than 'click' because most readers are on a phone.
Label under the hero number. Shown in small caps.
Puts the drill-down card away. One word — it sits opposite a title in a narrow header.

en: The most recently updated tickets in this status.
am: በዚህ ሁኔታ ውስጥ በቅርቡ የተዘመኑ ቲኬቶች።
om: Tikeetiiwwan dhiheenya kana haala kana keessatti haaromfaman.
ti: ኣብዚ ኩነታት ብቐረባ እዋን ዝተሓደሱ ትኬታት።
so: Tikidhada ugu dambeeyay ee la cusboonaysiiyay xaaladdan.
sw: Tiketi zilizosasishwa hivi karibuni katika hali hii.
note: Says what the drill-down list is, since 'the six most recent' and 'all of them' look identical when there are five.
Link out of the drill-down to the full filtered list. {n} is the count, so the reader knows whether the six they can see are most of it or a fraction.
